blockers.title: Once app_minimum_writer_version is installed, every restore stalls before its reload; the minimum writer is never adopted, so an app below the server minimum opens the restored course writable
blockers.evidence: finishRestore called adoptMinimumWriter after firstSync, before the reload; adoptMinimumWriter opens a guarded write transaction whose assertCourseSession throws CourseReplacedError because the tab's session is bound to 'no course' while the downloaded course is active. Live, with the RPC fulfilled by page.route ('0.5.0' and '9.0.0'): pageerror 'CourseReplacedError', screen 'Il corso è cambiato', state stays 'restoring', meta unchanged; after 'Riapri l'app' the course opens writable even at 9.0.0. Today's 404 is the only reason the restore reloads; the live read-only test called adoptMinimumWriter after the reload.
blockers.reproduction: Throwaway spec: one course for test account 1; route the RPC to '0.5.0' or '9.0.0'; goto '/', signInForTests, wait 25 s.

importantFindings.title: The minimum writer is read only once; any failure of that request skips it for good
importantFindings.evidence: Any RPC error was treated as 'not installed'; on later launches restoring is false and finishRestore never runs. Live: first RPC aborted, later 9.0.0: meta unchanged after a relaunch, rpc calls 1, not read-only.

importantFindings.title: The live minimum-writer test does not cover what it claims
importantFindings.evidence: It accepted a 404 and called adoptMinimumWriter directly after the restore had reloaded; routed through the restore, SC-B5-1 shows.
importantFindings.reproduction: Read the spec; route the RPC.

qolFindings.title: When the account's course arrives after B signed in to an empty account, B keeps offering 'Crea corso'; tapping it gives a misleading 'sostituito o eliminato' screen
qolFindings.evidence: Live, two contexts: B empty and connected; A uploads its course; B's database holds it but B still shows creation; the course-session guard refuses the creation; after a reopen both show A's course.

qolFindings.title: A restore that cannot download has no way out on the screen
qolFindings.evidence: With the PowerSync host blocked, the restore section had no button; signedOutElsewhere ignored 'restoring'. The interrupted restore itself recovered after a reload and signal.
qolFindings.reproduction: Block the PowerSync host, sign in, inspect, reload, unblock.

qolFindings.title: A local device holding the same course id as the account switches without asking and merges row by row
qolFindings.evidence: The question is asked only for a different id; an import keeps ids, so a device with the other phone's export would merge under keep_latest_edit and rows it deleted come back. By reading.
